summary_en: This systematic review maps the development of optoacoustic brain imaging and synthesizes advances spanning microscopy, tomography, multimodal integration, functional and molecular neuroimaging, and neurological-disease applications. It also identifies persistent challenges in spectral quantification, transcranial propagation, standardization, and clinical translation, making it a useful high-level reference for the repository.
